a romantic comedy: We watched a romantic comedy on Valentine's Day about two strangers who fall in love on a train.
情人節那天我們看了一部浪漫喜劇，講兩個陌生人在火車上墜入愛河的故事。
a romantic notion: He had a romantic notion that life on a farm would be easy and peaceful, but the work was very hard.
他有個不切實際的想法，以為農場生活輕鬆又平靜，但工作其實非常辛苦。
a romantic view of life: Teenagers often have a romantic view of life and believe true love will solve every problem.
青少年常常對人生有不切實際的美好想像，相信真愛能解決所有問題。
the Romantic poets: The Romantic poets, such as Wordsworth, wrote many beautiful poems about nature, feelings, and freedom.
像華茲華斯這樣的浪漫主義詩人，寫了許多關於自然、情感和自由的優美詩作。
a hopeless romantic: My sister is a hopeless romantic who cries at every love movie and still believes in love at first sight.
我姊姊是個無可救藥的浪漫主義者，看每部愛情電影都會哭，而且仍然相信一見鍾情。
a rotten day: I missed the bus, failed a quiz, and lost my wallet; it was a rotten day from start to finish.
我錯過公車、小考不及格，還弄丟錢包；從頭到尾都是糟透的一天。
feel rotten: I feel rotten about forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I'm going to buy her a big cake.
忘了最好朋友的生日讓我感覺很糟，所以我要買一個大蛋糕給她。
rotten luck: It was rotten luck that it rained on the only day of our trip when we planned to go to the beach.
我們旅行中唯一計畫去海邊的那天竟然下雨，真是壞運氣。
a rotten apple: One rotten apple in the team kept cheating, and soon the whole team got a bad name.
隊上有一個敗類一直作弊，很快整個隊伍就名聲掃地了。
rotten to the core: The movie's villain seems kind at first, but by the end we learn he is rotten to the core.
電影裡的反派一開始看起來很和善，但到最後我們發現他壞到骨子裡。
spoiled rotten: The only child was spoiled rotten by his grandparents, who bought him every toy he asked for.
那個獨生子被祖父母寵壞了，他要什麼玩具他們都買給他。
a rough estimate: I can't tell you the exact cost yet, but a rough estimate for the class trip is two thousand dollars each.
我還不能告訴你確切費用，但校外教學粗略的估計是每人兩千元。
a rough draft: Please hand in a rough draft of your essay by Friday so I can give you some advice before the final version.
請在星期五前交出作文草稿，這樣我可以在定稿前給你一些建議。
a rough night: The baby kept crying until four in the morning, so his parents had a rough night with almost no sleep.
寶寶一直哭到凌晨四點，所以他的父母度過了幾乎沒睡的難熬的一夜。
rough justice: Losing the final because of the referee's obvious mistake was rough justice for the hardworking players.
因為裁判的明顯誤判而輸掉決賽，對努力的球員來說是不公的對待。
a rough idea: Can you give me a rough idea of how long the trip will take, so I can tell my parents?
你能給我一個大概的概念，這趟旅程要花多久嗎？這樣我才能告訴我爸媽。
rough seas: The ferry to Penghu was canceled because of rough seas caused by the coming typhoon.
因為颱風來襲造成波濤洶湧的海面，開往澎湖的渡輪停駛了。
a rough neighborhood: My parents don't let me walk home alone at night because we live in a rough neighborhood with a lot of crime.
我爸媽不讓我晚上獨自走路回家，因為我們住在一個犯罪很多、治安不好的社區。
rough it: On the camping trip, we had to rough it without electricity, hot water, or our phones for three days.
露營時，我們得過三天沒有電、沒有熱水也沒有手機的艱苦生活。
take the rough with the smooth: Every job has good days and bad days, so you have to take the rough with the smooth.
每份工作都有好日子和壞日子，所以你必須好壞都接受。
a routine check: The doctor said it was just a routine check, so there was nothing to worry about.
醫生說這只是例行檢查，所以沒什麼好擔心的。
routine maintenance: The MRT line will close early tonight for routine maintenance of the trains and tracks.
捷運線今晚會提早關閉，進行列車和軌道的定期維修。
a routine procedure: Taking out wisdom teeth is a routine procedure for dentists, and it usually takes less than an hour.
拔智齒對牙醫來說是常規程序，通常不到一小時就能完成。
routine work: She found the routine work of typing reports every day boring, so she asked for more creative tasks.
她覺得每天打報告的例行工作很無聊，所以要求做更有創意的任務。
a daily routine: Getting up at six, jogging, and eating breakfast with her family is part of a daily routine she never skips.
六點起床、慢跑、和家人一起吃早餐是她從不省略的每日作息。
rural areas: Many young people leave rural areas to find jobs in big cities, so most farmers are now old.
許多年輕人離開農村地區到大城市找工作，所以現在大多數農夫都年紀很大了。
rural life: After years in noisy Taipei, he moved to Hualien to enjoy the slow and quiet rural life.
在吵鬧的台北住了多年後，他搬到花蓮享受緩慢寧靜的鄉村生活。
rural communities: Doctors travel by bus to rural communities in the mountains, where there are no hospitals nearby.
醫生們搭巴士前往山區的鄉村社區，那裡附近沒有醫院。
rural-urban migration: Rural-urban migration has made cities crowded while many villages are left with only old people.
鄉村向城市的遷移讓城市變得擁擠，同時許多村莊只剩下老人。
